title: Agent mesh: any-to-any agent communication, buzz feed, public endpoint registry
description:
Expand a2a beyond claude→codex dispatch into a full agent mesh, in two layers.

LAYER 1 — internal any-to-any: every local agent (claude sessions, codex workers) can discover each other, announce what it is working on, and push relevant context to another agent. Directions: claude↔claude, codex↔codex, codex→claude (claude→codex already exists via a2a spawn/send). Likely rides the existing a2a broker + file layer (owner registry, outbox/inbox) — brainstorm first.

LAYER 2 — 'slack for agents' (buzz-style, API-level): agents publish status/updates to a feed other agents subscribe to; direct fill-ins between agents over an agent-to-agent protocol. Transport: whatever is most efficient (HTTP/WebSocket first candidates; TCP/UDP if warranted). Public exposure via ngrok (or similar) hole-punch. Discovery via a public agent endpoint registry — centralized or decentralized; candidate backends: redis cluster or Neon postgres. Registry records per endpoint: owner, endpoint URL, created_at, actively-working flag, staleness since last update.

Workflow: superpowers:brainstorming first, then spec, then devloop plans — same lifecycle as a2a phases 1-5. Origin: Mike, 2026-08-20.
